delta_vs_baseline.note: Baseline was already 100% on functional test cases. Fixes addressed correctness bugs (null crash on new users) and observability gaps — not retrieval accuracy. The fixes prevent crashes and improve trace completeness, which are higher-value than accuracy delta on a passing suite.

qualitative_improvements: New guest login no longer crashes the server (critical correctness fix)
Guardrail decisions now visible in every trace — can be counted for the dashboard
Cache efficiency now measurable from traces — hit/miss rates surfaced per request
